text:
incident-bot: Pager alert — SEV2: inference latency spike in prod-west. p99 generation latency > 1200ms across embedder pool. auto-scale attempted and failed to clear backlog. link: https://pager.redwood/INC-1718302468

oncall-alex: acked — I'm on it. pulling logs and metrics now.

sre-maya: I see backlog on pool-gpu-2, kvcache evictions skyrocketed. moving traffic off pool-gpu-2 to pool-gpu-4 as hotfix.

oncall-alex: executing drain command now.

eng-jorge: quick note — recent rollout of quantized-embedder v2 landed on ~20% traffic in prod-west. could be related.

ops-ravi: scaling dedicated capacity +2 instances in us-west-2; ETA ~3m.

oncall-alex: ran: ```redwoodctl route shift --from pool-gpu-2 --to pool-gpu-4 --percent 100``` traffic shifted, observing metrics.

sre-maya: latency dropping on p95, p99 still noisy but improving. continuing to monitor for 10m.

pm-ellen: any initial estimate on customer impact? need to prepare comms if sustained.

eng-jorge: preliminary: some customers saw increased latency on embedding calls between 08:12-08:36 UTC. sampling traces show heavier KV cache miss rate for long-tail keys.

oncall-alex: mitigation looks stable at 08:22 UTC after routing change + scale. keeping oncall for 30m to ensure no regression.

incident-bot: Pager resolved — auto-note: incident moved to "post-incident" channel. INCIDENT-ID: INC-1718302468.

pm-ellen: scheduling postmortem — proposing 1718306000 (same day, 3h out) for 60m review.

sre-maya: +1. I'll prepare preliminary timeline and p99 graphs.

eng-jorge: I'll prepare list of recent deploys and config deltas (quantized-embedder rollout).

ops-ravi: will include capacity change logs and scaling events.

oncall-alex: quick action items from live mitigation: 1) Revert or pause quantized-embedder v2 rollout for prod-west (owner: eng-jorge, estimate: 0.5d, sev: high). 2) Add KV cache telemetry for long-tail keys (owner: sre-maya, estimate: 2d, sev: medium-high). 3) Harden auto-scale fallback to avoid repeated failed attempts (owner: ops-ravi, estimate: 3d, sev: medium). 4) Draft customer comms + credits assessment (owner: pm-ellen, estimate: 0.5d, sev: high).

pm-ellen: mapping to Q2 priorities: item 2 (cache telemetry) -> Q2 infra observability epic; item 3 (autoscale fallback) -> Q2 reliability sprint; item 1 (rollback) is immediate and not a roadmap ticket.

sre-maya: sizing note — item 2 could be split: a) quick metric (1d) to detect long-tail miss spikes, b) longer fix (3d) to aggregate and alert. mark as two sub-items.

eng-jorge: rollback paused rollout at 08:40 UTC. will confirm no further canary traffic.

oncall-alex: creating follow-up tickets in JIRA now, will tag with incident INC-1718302468 and link to postmortem.

pm-ellen: customer impact estimate for comms: ~120 customers possibly affected, 24 requests/min peak error of degraded latency, window ~24m. recommend offering credits for heavy-impacted customers.

ops-ravi: added remediation ticket and tentative priority: P1 for rollback, P2 for telemetry quick metric, P2 for autoscale fallback.

eng-jorge: note for postmortem — include traffic split history and KV cache eviction patterns.

incident-bot: Postmortem scheduled: 1718306000. Reminder will be posted 15m prior.

oncall-alex: thanks team. leaving detailed logs and runbook notes in the thread. next: handoff to remediation owners after postmortem. :thumbsup:

sre-maya: attaching quick commands used during live mitigation (paste):
```
redwoodctl scale pool pool-gpu-4 --replicas +2
redwoodctl route shift --from pool-gpu-2 --to pool-gpu-4 --percent 100
kubectl get pods -n inference -l pool=pool-gpu-2
```

pm-ellen: I'll draft the customer message and share for review in #product-commms.

oncall-alex: last check 08:45 UTC all clear. closing live pager thread and moving to remediation tracking.

eng-jorge: cc @sre-maya @ops-ravi — will own rollback verification and postmortem writeup.

sre-maya: will own telemetry tickets and initial RCA.

ops-ravi: will own autoscale fallback improvements.

pm-ellen: will own customer comms and credit calc.

incident-bot: Thread moved to remediation. ACTIONS: rollback (owner: eng-jorge, est: 0.5d), telemetry quick metric (owner: sre-maya, est: 1d), telemetry full (owner: sre-maya, est: 3d), autoscale fallback (owner: ops-ravi, est: 3d), comms (owner: pm-ellen, est: 0.5d). Priority mapping: rollback=P0, telemetry quick=P1, telemetry full=P2, autoscale=P2, comms=P1. Reference: INC-1718302468."
